requirements.title: Processors may support gradual or abrupt underflow mode control with performance latitude
requirements.source: S17.5 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: Some processors allow execution-time control over gradual underflow, producing subnormal numbers, versus abrupt underflow, producing zero; abrupt mode may improve performance.

pending.underflow-mode-control-processor-depende: No portable oracle requires underflow-mode control; fixtures first query IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL and skip control effects on the false branch.
pending.abrupt-underflow-performance-latitude: No portable oracle constrains performance; fixtures must not compare timings between gradual and abrupt modes.

requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. IEEE effects are tested only under explicit capability probes; the TRUE branch asserts the concrete flag, mode, type, constant, or operation effect, and the FALSE branch is a skip rather than a pass. Named FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE(flag,x): under IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,x), if IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(flag) then CALL IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(flag,.FALSE.); else CALL IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(flag,h) and proceed only if h is .FALSE. (otherwise skip); CALL IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_ALL,.FALSE.). Positive plans establish a non-default state first by setting distinguished sentinel values and apply FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE before any exception operation or flag-state assertion unless the row explicitly says the preamble is not applied because it would destroy the initial-state oracle.

S17.5-001 underflow-mode effect fixture: with support for datatype, subnormal values, and underflow control required by profile, TINY(X)/2.0 through volatile variables classifies as IEEE_POSITIVE_DENORMAL in gradual mode and equals positive zero in abrupt mode; timing/performance latitude is not asserted.

requirements.title: IEEE underflow mode procedures inquire, set, and restore supported modes
requirements.source: S17.5 p2.control-procedures, p2.initial-latitude, p2.procedure-restore; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE controls underflow mode, IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE gets it, IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL inquires support, the initial mode is processor dependent, and procedures other than IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE or IEEE_SET_STATUS preserve and restore the mode.

pending.initial-underflow-mode-processor-depende: No portable oracle fixes the initial underflow mode; fixtures save it at start and restore it at completion.
pending.underflow-mode-restored-on-procedure-ret: Guard probe: same helper changes mode to .false., calls IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE before return, and confirms .false. was the changed in-helper value. TRUE branch: caller GET observes original .true. after return, then restores the process initial mode. FALSE branch: skip.

S17.5-002 underflow-control fixture: IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(0.0) is asserted on the supported profile, GET returns the mode set by SET for .TRUE. and .FALSE. sentinels, SET to the opposite of a saved mode is observed before restoration, and a helper's entry GET sees the caller's .TRUE. mode.

requirements.title: Underflow mode affects only types whose support inquiry is true
requirements.source: S17.5 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: Underflow mode affects only floating-point calculations of a type corresponding to an X for which IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL returns true.

pending.underflow-mode-no-effect-assertion-for-s: Guard probe: IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(Y) returns false for a profiled kind Y. TRUE branch: set/get underflow mode using a supported kind elsewhere, then perform tiny calculations of kind Y only as a smoke run; no value difference is asserted. FALSE branch: skip.

accounting.rationale: Underflow-mode control and performance are processor-dependent permissions, with gradual/abrupt meanings recorded.
Control procedures, initial latitude, and procedure restore are split.
Initial underflow mode is processor dependent.
Underflow mode affects only calculations for supported types.

review_rationale: Batch309 bound reference-validated IEEE fixtures after one review round; frozen-LFortran failures (rounding modes ineffective, non-logical IEEE_SUPPORT_* results, missing IEEE_MODES_TYPE) were independently confirmed as genuine.
